prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art game character sprite sheet
Primary request: Create one clean 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet of the NEW Nhinh character from the provided references, shown in a LEFT-FACING SIDE VIEW. Use the first reference (contact sheet) and the next two references (new down-facing character frames) only to match Nhinh's outfit, palette, body proportions, pixel scale, and lantern design.
Scene/backdrop: truly transparent background.
Subject: The same small cloaked child adventurer in every cell: cream hood and cloak, brown hair visible at side, red scarf trailing behind, dark brown boots, small warm-gold handheld lantern held in the forward hand. Lantern must be visibly lit in every pose with a crisp bright golden core and a small controlled warm glow that stays close to the lantern.
Style/medium: crisp hand-authored-looking pixel art, hard pixel edges, limited palette and clear single-pixel details; match the low-resolution pixel-art appearance of the reference.
Composition/framing: 4 columns x 2 rows, eight equal transparent cells with no borders, no gaps or overlap. Reading left-to-right, top-to-bottom: idle; walk 0; walk 1; walk 2; run 0; run 1; run 2; empty transparent cell. One full character per occupied cell, centered horizontally; same apparent height and scale in all cells. Feet touch a common baseline within each row. Leave enough transparent padding between cells so figures and the lantern never cross cell boundaries. Side view faces screen-left, including lantern held in the forward/left hand. Walk poses show three distinct alternating steps. Run poses show three distinctly faster, longer-stride poses. No animation labels or any text.
Lighting/mood: lantern illumination clearly reads as bright, warm gold on the nearby cloak/hand.
Color palette: use the exact muted cream, reddish brown, scarf red, boot brown, and amber-gold family from the reference.
Materials/textures: deliberate pixel clusters; clean silhouette.
Constraints: transparent alpha, no ground or shadow, keep character design identical across poses, feet baseline consistent, readable at 36x42 after nearest-neighbor reduction; exclude all extraneous objects.
Avoid: photorealism, smooth vector edges, painterly blur, anti-aliasing, background color, grid lines, text, watermark, extra characters, unlit lantern, lantern missing, lantern carried on the rear hand, detached glow flecks, or body orientation other than facing left.
